summary: G-INFRA LP, a Delaware investment-advice registrant, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Senior Credit Agreement dated September 30, 2026 with Societe Generale as administrative agent, calculation agent, lead arranger and lender. The facility commits up to $50 million, with an uncommitted accordion permitting increase to $450 million. Margins are 2.85%/1.85% (Private Asset Tranche, benchmark/base) and 1.70%/0.70% (Liquid Asset Tranche), maturing September 28, 2029 and September 30, 2027 respectively, with a 50% maximum LTV covenant. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
